references.text: Psalm 41:1-3 speaks of the blessing of caring for the poor, which reflects the idea that the money could have been used to help the poor instead of buying perfume.
Isaiah 58:7 urges us to share our bread with the hungry and bring the homeless poor into our houses, which resonates with the thought of helping the poor.
Matthew 25:34-40 emphasizes the importance of serving the least of these as an act of serving Christ himself, reflecting the idea of giving to the poor.
James 2:15-16 discusses how faith without works, especially in the form of helping those in need, is dead, which corresponds with the idea that actions like giving to the poor are important.
